lines.t: Dust to dust, but something remains Through the fire, through the rain
Listen
Long after the glory of men fades out
And the rise of their kingdoms falls to the ground
When the towers they built are nowhere found
There's a love still echoing
Still resounding
When the crowns are rust and the names erased And the pride of power is stripped away
There's a whisper moving through time and space Saying love still stands, it won't decay
Yeah, don't break, don't bend Don't end, through the fall it remains
Long after it all turns to dust and disappears
That love still endures through the ages and years
When the stars burn out and the sky goes black
That love's still alive, never fading back
Deeper than time, wider than space
You cannot run it, you can't replace
To forever and always
It stays the same
That enduring love
Won't fade away
